title: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills
summary_full: Goldman Sachs is embracing AI, but one of its senior tech leaders warns that it comes with an unintended risk: weakening the reasoning skills of future bankers.
